ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Writing for Publication. Writing for Publication provides an opportunity for students to (1) professionally engage contemporary research, audiences, and scholarly venues in fields of inquiry relevant to their own scholarly disciplines; (2) participate in a community of scholarship through discussions, formal presentations, and intensive peer reviews of one another’s research and professional writings-in-process; and (3) submit their own work to a scholarly journal or professional society for evaluation, review, and/or possible publication.
